careers.title: Carraa Hojii | OBM Construction S.C.
careers.description: Iddoowwan hojii banaa fi carraa hojii OBM Construction S.C. keessatti sakatta'aa — dhaabbata ijaarsaa nageenya, qulqullina fi amanamummaa irratti ijaarame.
careers.heroDescription: Garee naannoo ijaarsaa Itiyoophiyaa nageenya, qulqullina fi amanamummaadhaan bocuuf walitti makamaa.
careers.whyObmDescription: Garee keenya kan injinariingii, hoogganoota pirojektii fi ogeeyyii saayitii wanta ijaaranitti boonan guddifachaa jirra.
careers.openPositionsDescription: Namoota hojii isaanii sirnaan hojjechuutti boonan barbaadaa jirra.
careers.benefitsDescription: Namoota nuuf ijaaran irratti investii goona.

opening.description: OBM Construction S.C. biraajjiraatti hojjechuuf iyyadhu.
opening.closedNotice: Karooraan hojii kun xumuramee dargi ilaalama kan hin qabne yoo ta'e.
opening.notFoundDesc: Karooraan hojii kun hojjetama yookaan adeemfamee ta'i. Iddoowwan banaa ammaa ilaali.
opening.speculativeDescription: Karooraa hojii ati itti gaafatamuu baatani ibsaami; erga reennan siif ni deebi'na.
opening.cvHint: PDF, DOC yookaan DOCX. 8 MB gabaabaan.
opening.certificatesHint: Filannoo. PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG yookaan PNG. 10 MB gabaabaan.
opening.consent: Ogeeffama armaan gadii sirrii ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuun yookaan OBM Construction S.C. ogummaa hireeef qabsiifuu qaba.
opening.successDescription: Iyyachuuf kennuf wanti. Garee hireeennii keenya iyyadhuwwan hundaa ilaala; abbaa ta'eegamaa dhuguu barreeffamaa ni gara.
opening.errorMessage: Iyyadhuun erguu hin danda'anne. Qabiyyee ilaali erga biraa ergadhu.

validation.positionRequired: Karooraa hojii ati itti gaafatte galchi.
validation.cvTooLarge: CV kee 8 MB gabaabaan ta'uu qabaachuu qaba.
validation.certificatesTooLarge: Faayilii wantee hayyamaa kee 10 MB gabaabaan ta'uu qabaachuu qaba.
